query Logs($resource: String!, $type: String, $text: String, $textMode: String, $level: [String!], $instance: [String!], $statusCode: [String!], $method: [String!], $path: [String!], $startTime: String, $endTime: String, $limit: Int) {
  logs(
    resource: $resource
    type: $type
    text: $text
    textMode: $textMode
    level: $level
    instance: $instance
    statusCode: $statusCode
    method: $method
    path: $path
    startTime: $startTime
    endTime: $endTime
    limit: $limit
  ) {
    hasMore
    nextStartTime
    nextEndTime
    logs {
      timestamp
      message
      type
      instance
      level
      method
      statusCode
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
